prompt: Compose one complete original 60-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: buoyant interlocking kora ostinatos and crisp percussion. Instruments: kora, calabash percussion, soft bass, shakers. Tempo 116 BPM. Distinct motif: a bright five-note arch. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 40-second lifestyle film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:58, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: A lively and upbeat instrumental piece featuring a prominent accordion melody, supported by a walking bassline and light percussion. The music has a cheerful, folk-dance feel, reminiscent of European or French cafe music.
description.zh: 一首活泼欢快的器乐曲，以手风琴为主旋律，配以行进的低音线和轻快的打击乐。音乐充满愉悦的民间舞曲氛围，让人联想到欧洲或法国咖啡馆的音乐风格。
